item.title: Meal - Honey Soy Chicken Stir Fry
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 400g
  • Mixed vegetables - 2 cups
  • Soy sauce - 2 tbsp
  • Honey - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 2 cloves
  • Rice - 2 cups cooked

Directions

  1. Cook chicken until browned
  2. Add vegetables and garlic
  3. Stir in soy sauce and honey
  4. Serve over rice

Macros

  • Calories - 510
  • Protein - 38g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 15g
